name: 11516 · Cedarhurst, NY
findings: ZIP 11516 (Cedarhurst) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11516 (Cedarhurst) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11516 (Cedarhurst) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do religious organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 27 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
